meaning: Assessed upstream tip with dispositions for each change

commits.subject: fix: try improve mouse debounce for video sync
commits.disposition: Already covered. USCE cancels pending previews when List or Chessboard selection changes and restarts its preview debounce for direct hover.

commits.subject: fix(#1390): reuse the loaded tile texture for the big song cover
commits.disposition: Adapted and tested in the open cover-reuse PR. The port borrows the loaded tile image with its own layout and keeps the tile alive while the detail view uses it. The port still awaits independent review.

commits.subject: fix(#1390): open the preview video only shortly before it becomes visible
commits.disposition: Already covered. USCE opens the video separately after the song selection and screen transition have settled, using its existing 150 ms debounce.
